text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"καὶ ταῖς ἀτυχίαις προθυμότερον βοηθῶν ἢ δέοντος, ἐδόκει συνεξομοιοῦσθαι ταῖς ἀδικίαις","english":"By assisting in their misfortunes more than he should have, he seemed to be complicit in their injustices.","kind":"sense","why":"The source says he seemed to be complicit in their injustices by helping them in their misfortunes, but the English implies he was complicit in the injustices themselves.","certainty":"medium"},{"source":"καὶ φύσας ἑαυτῷ πολεμικώτερον εἶναι γυνητίναν, ὑπεξῆλθε μετὰ παίδων καὶ γυναικός","english":"and having decided that it was more warlike for him to be a woman, he withdrew with his children and wife.","kind":"sense","why":"The source says he decided it was more warlike to be 'womanly' (or submissive/yielding), not that he decided to be a woman.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.source: καὶ ταῖς ἀτυχίαις προθυμότερον βοηθῶν ἢ δέοντος, ἐδόκει συνεξομοιοῦσθαι ταῖς ἀδικίαις
contradictions.english: By assisting in their misfortunes more than he should have, he seemed to be complicit in their injustices.
contradictions.why: The source says he seemed to be complicit in their injustices by helping them in their misfortunes, but the English implies he was complicit in the injustices themselves.

contradictions.source: καὶ φύσας ἑαυτῷ πολεμικώτερον εἶναι γυνητίναν, ὑπεξῆλθε μετὰ παίδων καὶ γυναικός
contradictions.english: and having decided that it was more warlike for him to be a woman, he withdrew with his children and wife.
contradictions.why: The source says he decided it was more warlike to be 'womanly' (or submissive/yielding), not that he decided to be a woman.
